base: Prices are per load, by how much of a standard junk truck it fills (about 400 cubic feet: 10 ft long, 8 ft wide, 5 ft high), for household junk picked up at the curb, in a garage or on the ground floor, dump and recycling fees included. Stairs, long carries and heavy debris scale them.

factors.label: Where the items are
factors.basis: Fixr: heavy items that need extra labor cost more, and items may need extra labor when they come from a second floor. LawnStarter: heavy and oversized items cost more.
factors.note: Judgment call: the 15 percent for stairs and long carries is ours. The sources say only that these jobs cost more.

sources.says: Heavy items that require additional labor to lift and move also have higher costs. Other items may require additional labor, particularly if they are removed from a second floor.
Heavy and oversized items cost more to haul away.

factors.label: What it is
factors.basis: Fixr: construction debris $200 to $600, and some transfer stations charge more for construction debris. HomeAdvisor: construction debris, gravel or dirt $100 to $800 a truckload. LawnStarter: construction debris $300 to $800 a truckload.
factors.note: Judgment call: the 25 percent for heavy debris is ours. Heavy debris also fills the truck by weight before it fills it by space, so the Load estimate checks the weight too.

sources.says: Construction debris removal $200 to $600; some transfer stations charge additional fees for construction debris disposal.
Construction debris, gravel or dirt removal $100 to $800 per truckload.

addons.label: Appliance with refrigerant
addons.basis: HomeGuide: refrigerators and freezers carry a disposal surcharge of about $35 to $60 each; HomeAdvisor: refrigerant (freon) removal $50 to $150. The space it takes is priced in the load.
addons.note: For a fridge, freezer, dehumidifier or AC unit. The refrigerant has to be recovered before disposal (EPA Section 608): check your county for who does it and what the dump charges.

sources.says: Freezers and refrigerators: $35 to $60 each. Some landfills also charge a refrigerant or freon removal fee for refrigerators and window air conditioning units.
